classification: hand-written AES-NI implementation released as a versioned package; verified end to end and above the source-site record
candidate_origin: hand-written kernel authored in this workspace from the vendor reference implementation; the vendor Optimized_Implementation was not used as a generation input

measurement.unit: table columns are TSC ticks/byte at 1024 B (site convention); TSC-derived, not hardware core cycles. ns/byte is recorded per size as well.
measurement.sampling: adaptive repetitions per size targeting ~50 ms per round, 8 sizes, 3 rounds
measurement.harness: package test/bench.c (ships inside the ZIP, rebuilt by build_and_verify.sh)

baseline.official_optimized: vendor Optimized_Implementation/Garnet_768/Garnet_768.S, exact archive bytes sha256 46a115bd1af10768735b73f18b2e12f17756930c509292b5f3469b1b03286ea6 from hash-11/orig.zip
baseline.degenerate_reason: the vendor optimized assembly is 1.78x SLOWER than the vendor reference at every message length; the published ratio therefore compares against a genuinely weak official baseline, and the reference ratio is the honest cross-check

verification.package_kat: 4 KAT files regenerated byte-identical for reference, official and CryptoCode (KAT_2_12 4097 records, KAT_2_23 3, KAT_2_33 3, KAT_Loop 1)
verification.package_cross_comparison: 103 legal inputs (empty, block/padding boundaries, non-byte-aligned bit lengths): reference vs official and reference vs CryptoCode both identical
verification.guarded_correctness: 8329 differential cases + ASan/UBSan on both sides + 4 KATs, status passed (workspace registration garnet768-brain3-aesni-v1)
verification.acceptance_extract: final ZIP unzipped into a fresh directory; sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS -> 66/66 OK
verification.acceptance_rebuild: build_and_verify.sh re-run in that fresh directory: build_all_three ok, kat_byte_identical_to_published yes, cross_implementation_digests 2/2 identical, verdict PASS
verification.acceptance_reproduction: geomean opt/our reproduced at 3.9143 in the acceptance run vs 3.9318 in the packaged run

disclosures: The vendor Optimized_Implementation assembly is 1.78x slower than the vendor reference, so the official-optimized column is a weak baseline; both ratios are published.
The vendor assembly only exports the core block function and expects a pre-padded buffer; the package ships a disclosed adapter that performs the padding the vendor main_768.c performs.
The vendor CryptHash_Garnet.c dispatch adapter references 512/768/1024 entry points and is unusable as-is; the package ships a digest-scoped shim instead.
License status unresolved: the vendor sources carry the ICCS notice only.
KAT and cross-comparison passing are correctness evidence, not a security or constant-time proof.
TSC ticks/byte is a TSC-derived figure, not hardware core cycles.
notes: one algorithm-version package covers the accepted instance; the legacy instances/Garnet-768.zip binary remains in the tree but is no longer referenced by the table
builds run under WSL gcc 14.2.0 on Linux 6.18 (WSL2), Intel i7-14650HX; MinGW cannot assemble the vendor .S
prebuilt libraries are hash-bound to source and flags; only freshly built libraries were measured
